text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Closing out the year is none other than the Triple Crown Umamusume!
She remained unstoppable right down to the very end!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOAAAAAAAAAAHH!!)

At Rhine Kraft's request, I came to watch
the big year-end race on this day.

However, Sweep Tosho, one of the girls she looked
up to, unfortunately finished in 10th place.
Just as I thought she'd be terribly frustrated—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: The Umamusume who took 1st place was amazing, wasn't she!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
It felt like she rushed past with a *whoosh*,
ready to take off and fly as far as she could.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: As expected of a Triple Crown Umamusume.
choice_data_list: ...You should praise the Triple Crown Umamusume instead.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Aah!
Of course I was cheering for you too, Sweep-san! All the way!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
But today...
I just wanted to take a little peek.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"The race of an Umamusume who continued along
a path completely opposite to the one I walked."
choice_data_list: So, what did you think after seeing it in person?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Huh? —Fufu, that's true~
Hmm... I guess the way we build our futures might be different, too.
choice_data_list: Is the way we shape the future different?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yes! For us Tiara Umamusume, it's like we're passing it directly forward... like a single connecting thread.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Just like Air Messiah and
Messiah's mother, a bond
between parent and child."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Like the master-pupil bond I saw as a child
between the Oaks Umamusume
and her teacher.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Forging a special bond where we resonate and inspire one another.
I guess that's how we build the future together.

—Suddenly, I recall the moment
Rhein Kraft woke up from her sleep.

That day, everyone gathered in the hospital room
took Rhein Kraft's hand,
praying from the bottom of their hearts for her to wake.

The way their hearts connected
might very well have been the work of fate.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Compared to that,
the folks on the Classic Triple Crown route
have such incredible explosive power!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Just being on the Triple Crown route draws everyone's attention, you know? The power they have to attract popularity is amazing, too!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Even today, she had this powerful presence that moved everyone.
And that's how... I feel she created an era."
choice_data_list: Will you forge the future through the era you yourself created?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Like... BAM!
Then... BAAAAAAM!
choice_data_list: That got abstract all of a sudden, huh.
That got abstract all of a sudden, huh?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Mmph...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, for now!
I can't say for sure which one is better, but—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I was just thinking that having those two different ways of shaping the future is what makes the racing world so exciting.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Because it wasn't just the Tiara route.
Because it wasn't just the Classic Triple Crown route.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I felt like people from all generations,
living in all kinds of places,
truly loved racing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together, we suddenly look up at the sky,
imagining the future that lies ahead—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
—...Please look forward to it.
To the next generation that we create, as well.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I'm sure it'll be fascinating.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Rhein Kraft smiled, her eyes narrowing with sheer, radiant happiness.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I felt like people from all generations,
living in all kinds of places,
truly loved racing.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Aah, so close, though.
If only my best distance
was just a little bit longer.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
And if we did,
don't you think we could've set up a showdown
between a Triple Tiara and a Triple Crown winner?
choice_data_list: Why not just challenge them directly to a mile race?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ah, that might be nice too! ...Just kidding! Ehehe!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
—...Well, even if it's not "now."
Even if it's not "me" who makes it come true.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I believe a future where a Triple Tiara Umamusume
and a Triple Crown Umamusume clash
is bound to come.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Certainly. Without fail.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Fufu. After all—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Both the Tiara Umamusume and the Triple Crown Umamusume have bright futures ahead of them—they're supposed to be "strong," after all!
